- Mina is an IC3 who delivered the multi-region cache migration (Q4) that materially reduced tail latency for the serving layer and unlocked a 3x throughput step for a key customer.
- She has multiple competitive offers; recruiting alerted me last week. Retention risk is high and would jeopardize the product roadmap.

Requested exceptions (one-off, single transaction):
- Base salary increase: 12% bump (effective next paycheck) — this exceeds band midpoint guidance for Eng3 in our current comp bands.
- Spot bonus: USD 10,000 (one-time)
- Equity refresh: 1,500 RSUs (4-year schedule) — above the normal refresh for Eng3 but below L4 typical grants.

Budget / justification:
- I recommend funding from the infra spot budget for FY26 Q1 (we have ~USD 120k remaining). Impact on team Opex: ~USD 45k first-year cash (salary proration + bonus) and equity budget of ~1.5k RSUs.

Attachments include: merit_case_Mina.pdf (summary of accomplishments & manager calibration), comp_justification.xlsx (budget and band comparables).

Ask: please approve this exception and confirm any changes needed for legal/total comp packaging. If approved, can Monica / People Ops run the paperwork and routing to payroll?
